title: The Aviary and Bill Moore's MUFON speech

tellings.quote: the aviary was this long rumored uh like it was like bird code names assigned to kind of disinfo agents around UFO related truth. So people like Rick Dodie, John Leer, uh it's kind of associated with Bill Moore and the agents where he made that muon speech

plain: In the 1980s, the story goes, a group known as the Aviary, made up of insiders with bird code names, worked as agents spreading false information about the truth of UFOs. Michels describes it himself as "long rumored" and links it to the former Air Force intelligence agent Rick Doty, the pilot John Lear, and the UFO writer Bill Moore, and to a speech Moore gave to MUFON, a large civilian UFO research group. If true, some of the best-known UFO stories of that decade were planted on purpose.
